ablation.name: d2_moment_hf1_15ep
ablation.notes: D2: High-order moment matching (skewness+kurtosis) on HF DWT subbands. Captures intra-channel distribution shape that Gram (inter-channel 2nd order) and SWD (per-pixel marginal) both miss. w_moment_hf=1.0, w_moment_ll=0 (protect content). Goal: DINO-sty improvement complementary to D1.
